title: After successfully sending an e-mail I receive the Thunderbird message that no copy could be save in my sent folder.
creator: torsten.trotzki
content:
I use Thunderbird for managing two different e-mail accounts: 1st account by Google, 2nd by Telekom/T-Online (both IMAP).

The following problem only occurs for the 2nd account.

After successfully sending an e-mail I receive the Thunderbird message that no copy could be save in my sent folder. The problem occurs only when I am using my private WLAN connection. It occurs not if I am using my mobile internet connection. 

It occurs in both Thunderbird application (Windows 11 and Android 16). The WLAN router has no DNS filter setting. Also the firewall has no special filter settings for the Thunderbird application.

I also rebuild the sent folder using the rebuild function of Thunderbird. but the problem remains.

The problem remains while using the troubleshooting mode.
